principles: Use verified opaque student, occurrence, edition, page, question and revision identities. Names and labels are display-only.
Keep regular academy lessons and makeup occurrences separate, retaining makeup origin identity when verified.
Keep source observations separate from teacher present/future plans. Approval does not turn a teacher plan into a source fact.
Use local lesson calendar date and explicit time zone, independently of source observation timestamps.
Never infer no work, no lesson, correctness, correction completion or mastery from missing records.
Preserve teacher-owned cells, formula cells, annotations, protections, every non-target tab and existing legacy consumers.
Read source facts and append-only teacher history into a deterministic projection. This code performs no live persistence.
A source-coverage flag is caller evidence, not proof produced by this library. Overview counts include only students present in supplied entries.

output: weeklyOverview: local week → exact lesson/session lane → textbook edition
notes: currentRevisions validates full append-only history before projecting latest entity states
Month/date/time/student filters are conjunctive. A date outside its selected month is rejected.
Student and hierarchy detail filters do not hide other supplied students from the same date/time overview.
Unknown time or hierarchy matches remain in a separate unresolved queue rather than disappearing.
Unknown exact source bindings stay explicitly unresolved and cannot establish plan completion.
Stale observations remain visible but are excluded from reconciliation.
Freshness describes observedAt relative to caller policy, not proof that the original source timestamp is known.
Hierarchy filters narrow presentation only. Whole-plan reconciliation uses all current fresh verified observations with the same time zone and exact compatible source identities.
Foreign-time-zone rows remain unresolved before local month/date/time filtering; no guessed conversion or temporal period is assigned.
weekStart is the Monday date in the explicitly selected time zone. Source timestamps never supply the lesson week.
Month and week filters intersect across month boundaries. Non-Monday weeks, a date outside its selected week, and nonoverlapping month/week selections are rejected.

Weekly grouping comes from projectLearningWeeks over validated history. Deeper hierarchy selectors prune display rows consistently; full-plan reconciliation remains based on all compatible fresh verified evidence.
Foreign-time-zone rows receive no guessed week or temporal period. Their uncertainty remains in the top-level unresolved queue.

questionAuditRules: Known catalog pages can expand into question rows for display, but page-level evidence never becomes a question grade.
Direct question evidence retains source system, contract reference, source timestamp knowledge, observation time, entity and revision IDs.
A scalar grade or correction on multiple questions is not broadcast to each question; per-question states remain unknown.
App correctness, reported completion, correction checking and teacher inspection are separate fields.
Teacher-inspected question status requires one exact question, explicit teacher observation, checked correction, verified identity and fresh evidence.
Unknown occurrence rows are partitioned by entity and never merged solely by student/date.
No mastery, ability ranking, pace score, time-spent weight or automatic homework assignment is produced.
A known catalog question path does not supply a missing source edition binding. Unknown source edition keeps per-question evidence identity unresolved and prevents teacher-inspected status.

Verify exact student, lesson, textbook and app evidence joins with complete source coverage
Present target, exact before/after values and recovery method for teacher approval
Persist and verify the pre-change snapshot before any separately approved writer runs
Reject stale or concurrent changes, preserve teacher edits, and read back the same exact target after the batch
